title: This lint checks for equality comparisons with ptr::null or ptr::null_mut
summary: It’s easier and more readable to use the inherent .is_null() method instead Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for conversions to owned values just for the sake of a comparison.
summary: The comparison can operate on a reference, so creating an owned value effectively throws it away directly afterwards, which is needlessly consuming code and heap space. Clippy puts this lint in the perf group, at the level warn.
